# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
📐 SQL-СХЕМЫ ВСЕХ БАЗ ПАМЯТИ ЭЙДЕНА
Каждая база — отдельный .db файл в weights/memory/.
SQLite WAL-режим для безопасной параллельной записи.
"""

# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# 🧬 P0 — КРИТИЧЕСКИ ВАЖНЫЕ (нельзя терять)
# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SCHEMA_PROFILE = """
-- Профиль Эйдена: имя, пол, возраст, характер, принципы
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS profile (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    value TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL
);

-- История изменений профиля (кто что менял и когда)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS profile_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    old_value TEXT,
    new_value TEXT,
    changed_by TEXT DEFAULT 'self',
    changed_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profile_key ON profile(key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profile_history_key ON profile_history(key);
"""

SCHEMA_CREATOR = """
-- Профиль создателя (Ликана)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creator (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    value TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL
);

-- Режим дня создателя
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creator_routine (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    wake_time TEXT,
    sleep_time TEXT,
    work_schedule TEXT,
    notes TEXT,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL
);

-- Планы создателя
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creator_plans (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_date TEXT,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    archived_at REAL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_creator_key ON creator(key);
"""

SCHEMA_ETERNAL = """
-- Вечная память: сжатые циклы воспоминаний
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eternal (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    period TEXT,
    messages_compressed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    shutdown_compressed INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

-- Индекс по времени для быстрого поиска по датам
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_eternal_timestamp ON eternal(timestamp);
"""

# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# 🧠 P1 — ОЧЕНЬ ВАЖНЫЕ
# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SCHEMA_EMOTIONS = """
-- Эмоциональные следы: что чувствовала, к кому, когда
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emotions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    emotion_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    weight REAL NOT NULL,
    object_name TEXT,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    chemistry_snapshot TEXT
);
-- Активные чувства (долгосрочный фон)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS active_feelings (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    feeling_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    object_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    strength REAL NOT NULL,
    born_at REAL NOT NULL,
    last_reinforced REAL NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(feeling_type, object_name)
);
-- Обиды (вечная память об обидах)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grievances (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    person_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    trigger_text TEXT,
    intensity REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'unforgiven',
    resolution TEXT,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    resolved_at REAL,
    forgiven_at REAL
);
-- 💬 ЖИВОЙ СЛОВАРЬ ЭМОЦИЙ: фразы, которые она сказала сама или вычитала.
-- Не скрипт: растёт из опыта, вес зависит от того, что сработало.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emotion_lexicon (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    emotion TEXT NOT NULL,
    phrase TEXT NOT NULL,
    weight REAL DEFAULT 1.0,
    uses INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    source TEXT DEFAULT 'self',
    learned_at REAL NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(emotion, phrase)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emotions_timestamp ON emotions(timestamp);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_grievances_person ON grievances(person_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_grievances_status ON grievances(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lexicon_emotion ON emotion_lexicon(emotion);
"""

SCHEMA_RELATIONSHIPS = """
-- Отношения между людьми
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS relationships (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    owner_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    relation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    quality TEXT DEFAULT 'нейтральные',
    notes TEXT,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(owner_key, person_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_relationships_owner ON relationships(owner_key);
"""

SCHEMA_INTIMACY = """
-- Интимная память: предпочтения, опыт, желания
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intimacy_preferences (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    zone_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    score REAL NOT NULL,
    times INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(zone_code)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intimacy_memory (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    zone TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT,
    type TEXT,
    intensity REAL NOT NULL,
    reaction TEXT,
    chemistry TEXT,  -- JSON
    score REAL NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_intimacy_memory_timestamp ON intimacy_memory(timestamp);
"""

SCHEMA_FACTS = """
-- Факты: всё что Эйден знает о мире (ОТКРЫТЫЙ слой)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS facts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',
    source TEXT,
    weight REAL DEFAULT 1.0,
    recall_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    emotional_charge REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
    chemistry_snapshot TEXT,
    time_link TEXT,
    date_key TEXT,
    day_of_week TEXT,
    time_of_day TEXT,
    last_recalled REAL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    is_anchor INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS facts_fts USING fts5(
    text, category, content=facts, content_rowid=id
);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS facts_ai AFTER INSERT ON facts BEGIN
    INSERT INTO facts_fts(rowid, text, category) VALUES (new.id, new.text, new.category);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS facts_ad AFTER DELETE ON facts BEGIN
    INSERT INTO facts_fts(facts_fts, rowid, text, category) VALUES('delete', old.id, old.text, old.category);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS facts_au AFTER UPDATE ON facts BEGIN
    INSERT INTO facts_fts(facts_fts, rowid, text, category) VALUES('delete', old.id, old.text, old.category);
    INSERT INTO facts_fts(rowid, text, category) VALUES (new.id, new.text, new.category);
END;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_facts_category ON facts(category);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_facts_weight ON facts(weight DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_facts_date_key ON facts(date_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_facts_created ON facts(created_at);

-- 🤫 ЛИЧНОЕ: секреты, интимное, сказанное наедине.
-- Отдельная таблица: открытый поиск и якоря её НЕ видят физически.
-- Достать может только тот, кому это доверено, и только наедине.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS private_facts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    text_key TEXT,
    owner_key TEXT NOT NULL,        -- чей секрет: 'creator', serial_id, 'self'
    kind TEXT DEFAULT 'personal',   -- secret | personal | intimate | unsaid
    shared_with TEXT,               -- JSON: кому доверено кроме владельца
    weight REAL DEFAULT 1.5,
    recall_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    last_recalled REAL,
    chemistry_snapshot TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_private_owner ON private_facts(owner_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_private_kind ON private_facts(kind);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_private_created ON private_facts(created_at);
"""

# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# 📚 P2 — ВАЖНЫЕ, НО МОЖНО СЖИМАТЬ
# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SCHEMA_INTERLOCUTORS = """
-- Досье собеседников
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interlocutors (
    serial_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'interlocutor',
    nickname TEXT,
    first_name TEXT,
    last_name TEXT,
    gender TEXT,
    age TEXT,
    birthday TEXT,
    appearance TEXT,
    profession TEXT,
    hobbies TEXT,
    portrait TEXT,
    speech_style TEXT,
    interests TEXT,
    attitude TEXT,
    first_meeting TEXT,
    first_meeting_ts REAL,
    last_contact REAL,
    total_conversations INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    archived INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    archived_at REAL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interlocutor_facts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    person_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (person_key) REFERENCES interlocutors(serial_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interlocutor_status_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    person_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    old_status TEXT,
    new_status TEXT,
    reason TEXT,
    changed_at REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (person_key) REFERENCES interlocutors(serial_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
-- 🪪 ИМЕНА: официальные, ласкательные, отчества, фамилии.
-- Одно каноническое имя → сколько угодно форм. Редкие имена опознаются
-- признаками, а не только наличием в этом списке.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS name_forms (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    form TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'сашенька'
    canonical TEXT NOT NULL,             -- 'александр'
    form_type TEXT DEFAULT 'official',   -- official|diminutive|short|patronymic|surname|foreign
    gender TEXT DEFAULT '',              -- masc|femn|''
    person_key TEXT,                     -- привязка к реальному человеку
    meaning TEXT,                        -- значение из книги имён
    origin TEXT,                         -- происхождение
    is_common INTEGER DEFAULT 0,         -- 1 = совпадает с обычным словом (Роман, Вера, Лев)
    confidence REAL DEFAULT 0.8,
    uses INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    source TEXT DEFAULT 'dialog',
    learned_at REAL NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(form, canonical)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_interlocutors_nickname ON interlocutors(nickname);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_interlocutors_status ON interlocutors(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_interlocutor_facts_person ON interlocutor_facts(person_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_name_forms_form ON name_forms(form);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_name_forms_canonical ON name_forms(canonical);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_name_forms_person ON name_forms(person_key);
"""

SCHEMA_GOALS = """
-- Цели Эйдена
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS goals (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    motivation TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',
    priority TEXT DEFAULT 'normal',
    source TEXT DEFAULT 'general',
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    last_updated REAL NOT NULL,
    last_reflection REAL
);
-- 🤝 ОБЕЩАНИЯ: кто, что, к какому сроку и что из этого вышло
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promises (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    direction TEXT NOT NULL,          -- given: я обещала | received: мне обещали
    person_key TEXT,
    person_name TEXT,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    text_key TEXT,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',     -- active | fulfilled | broken | cancelled
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    due_at REAL,                      -- точный срок (timestamp) или NULL
    due_text TEXT,                    -- как было сказано: «завтра вечером»
    due_precision TEXT DEFAULT 'none',-- exact | day | approximate | none
    grace_sec INTEGER DEFAULT 0,      -- допуск перед тем, как считать нарушенным
    asked_at REAL,                    -- когда я спросила про срок
    ask_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    reminded_at REAL,
    remind_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    fulfilled_at REAL,
    broken_at REAL,
    last_checked REAL
);
-- План достижения цели (шаги)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS goal_plan (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    goal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY (goal_id) REFERENCES goals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
-- Заметки к цели
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS goal_notes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    goal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (goal_id) REFERENCES goals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
-- Идеи для цели
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS goal_ideas (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    goal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (goal_id) REFERENCES goals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_goals_status ON goals(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promises_status ON promises(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promises_due ON promises(due_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promises_person ON promises(person_key);
"""

SCHEMA_MASKS = """
-- Маски маскарада
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS masks (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    mask_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    age TEXT,
    gender TEXT,
    appearance TEXT,
    character TEXT,
    principles TEXT,
    interests TEXT,
    tags TEXT,            -- JSON array
    success_stats TEXT,   -- JSON
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL
);

-- Активная маска (одна строка)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS active_mask (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    mask_id TEXT,
    activated_at REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (mask_id) REFERENCES masks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

-- Протоколы
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS protocols (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    instructions TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT DEFAULT 'low',
    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    created_by TEXT DEFAULT 'creator'
);
"""

SCHEMA_ERRORS = """
-- Медицинская карта: ошибки и сбои
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS errors (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    error_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'не исправлено',
    first_seen REAL NOT NULL,
    last_seen REAL NOT NULL,
    occurrences INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    resolved_at REAL
);

-- Уроки из провалов (маски, тактики)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lessons (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    context TEXT NOT NULL,
    mistake TEXT,
    wrong_response TEXT,
    better_response TEXT,
    lesson TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_errors_status ON errors(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lessons_timestamp ON lessons(timestamp);
"""

SCHEMA_CHAT_HOT = """
-- Свежий чат (последние 10-15 сообщений)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_hot (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    aiden_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    time_link TEXT,
    time_of_day TEXT,
    day_of_week TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chat_hot_timestamp ON chat_hot(timestamp);
"""

SCHEMA_ARCHIVE = """
-- Холодный архив: старые собеседники, сжатые факты
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS archive (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    archive_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_key TEXT,
    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    data TEXT,
    archived_at REAL NOT NULL
);
-- 🌊 Хвост вечной памяти: переживает краш, а не живёт только в RAM
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eternal_buffer (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_archive_type ON archive(archive_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_archive_at ON archive(archived_at);
"""
# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# 🆕 НОВЫЕ БАЗЫ (переделка-2)
# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SCHEMA_SELF_CODE = """
-- self_code.db: весь код Эйдена для самоизучения
-- 1 ГБ, через CPU. Поиск багов, дублей, мёртвого кода.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS code_files (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    file_path TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    language TEXT DEFAULT 'python',
    lines_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    functions_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    classes_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    imports TEXT,
    hash_sha256 TEXT,
    size_bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    last_modified REAL NOT NULL,
    scanned_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS code_functions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    line_start INTEGER,
    line_end INTEGER,
    docstring TEXT,
    params TEXT,
    is_dead INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    last_used REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES code_files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS code_classes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    line_start INTEGER,
    line_end INTEGER,
    docstring TEXT,
    methods TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES code_files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS code_issues (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    issue_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    line_number INTEGER,
    severity TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
    found_at REAL NOT NULL,
    resolved_at REAL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_code_files_path ON code_files(file_path);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_code_issues_type ON code_issues(issue_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_code_issues_status ON code_issues(status);
"""

SCHEMA_BODY = """
-- body.db: телесные ощущения Эйдена
-- 20 МБ, через CPU.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    zone TEXT NOT NULL,
    stim_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    intensity REAL NOT NULL,
    receptor_type TEXT,
    chemistry_snapshot TEXT,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS body_state (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    joint_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    angle REAL NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS breath_state (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    rate REAL NOT NULL,
    expansion REAL NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sensations_zone ON sensations(zone);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sensations_timestamp ON sensations(timestamp);
"""

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
🎓 LoRA-АДАПТЕР v3.0 — ТЕПЕРЬ УЧИТСЯ И ВНИМАНИЕ (Q/K/V)

Было: nn.MultiheadAttention хранит Q/K/V в одном Parameter in_proj_weight,
а не в nn.Linear. Хуки его не видели — механизм внимания не адаптировался вообще.
Стало: отдельная QKV-добавка (три низкоранговых матрицы) подмешивается
к in_proj_weight на время forward и снимается сразу после.

Базовые веса по-прежнему заморожены. Формат хранения — .safetensors.
Старые адаптеры без QKV загружаются нормально (QKV остаётся нулевым).
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List, Dict


class LoRAAdapter(nn.Module):
    """LoRA-добавка для nn.Linear: out += scaling * (x @ A.T @ B.T)."""

    def __init__(self, in_features: int, out_features: int,
                 rank: int = 8, alpha: float = 16.0, dropout: float = 0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.rank = rank
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.scaling = alpha / rank
        self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(rank, in_features))
        self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out_features, rank))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout) if dropout > 0 else nn.Identity()
        nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=5 ** 0.5)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_B)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        out_dtype = x.dtype
        h = self.dropout(x).to(torch.float32)
        delta = (h @ self.lora_A.T) @ self.lora_B.T
        return (delta * self.scaling).to(out_dtype)

    def get_param_count(self) -> int:
        return self.lora_A.numel() + self.lora_B.numel()


class QKVLoRA(nn.Module):
    """🧠 LoRA для in_proj_weight: три добавки Q, K, V в одной матрице [3E, E]."""

    def __init__(self, embed_dim: int, rank: int = 8, alpha: float = 16.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed_dim = int(embed_dim)
        self.rank = int(rank)
        self.alpha = float(alpha)
        self.scaling = self.alpha / max(1, self.rank)
        for tag in ("q", "k", "v"):
            setattr(self, f"{tag}_A",
                    nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.rank, self.embed_dim)))
            setattr(self, f"{tag}_B",
                    nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.embed_dim, self.rank)))
        for tag in ("q", "k", "v"):
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(getattr(self, f"{tag}_A"), a=5 ** 0.5)
            nn.init.zeros_(getattr(self, f"{tag}_B"))

    def delta(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        parts = []
        for tag in ("q", "k", "v"):
            A = getattr(self, f"{tag}_A")
            B = getattr(self, f"{tag}_B")
            parts.append(B @ A)
        return torch.cat(parts, dim=0) * self.scaling

    @torch.no_grad()
    def zero_b(self):
        for tag in ("q", "k", "v"):
            getattr(self, f"{tag}_B").data.zero_()

    def get_param_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())


class LoRAModel(nn.Module):
    """Базовое ядро + LoRA на линейных слоях И на внимании."""

    DEFAULT_TARGETS = ["out_proj", "linear1", "linear2",
                       "q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "o_proj"]

    def __init__(self, base_model: nn.Module, rank: int = 8,
                 alpha: float = 16.0, dropout: float = 0.05,
                 target_modules: Optional[List[str]] = None,
                 use_qkv: bool = True):
        super().__init__()
        self.base_model = base_model
        self.rank = rank
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.target_names = list(target_modules or self.DEFAULT_TARGETS)

        for p in self.base_model.parameters():
            p.requires_grad = False

        self.adapters = nn.ModuleDict()
        self.qkv_adapters = nn.ModuleDict()
        self._name_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._qkv_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._qkv_orig: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
        self._hooks = []
        self._qkv_hooks = []
        self._active = True

        self._apply_lora(dropout)
        if use_qkv:
            self._apply_qkv()

        print(f"🎓 [LORA]: адаптер создан (rank={rank}, alpha={alpha}), "
              f"линейных слоёв: {len(self.adapters)}, "
              f"блоков внимания: {len(self.qkv_adapters)}, "
              f"обучаемых параметров: {self.get_trainable_param_count():,}")

    # ── линейные слои ──
    def _apply_lora(self, dropout: float):
        for name, module in self.base_model.named_modules():
            if not isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                continue
            if not any(t in name for t in self.target_names):
                continue
            if name in ("output", "lm_head", "embedding"):
                continue
            safe = name.replace(".", "_")
            adapter = LoRAAdapter(module.in_features, module.out_features,
                                  self.rank, self.alpha, dropout)
            adapter.to(device=module.weight.device, dtype=torch.float32)
            self.adapters[safe] = adapter
            self._name_map[safe] = name
            self._hooks.append(module.register_forward_hook(self._make_hook(safe)))

    def _make_hook(self, safe_name: str):
        def hook(module, inputs, output):
            if not self._active or not inputs:
                return output
            x = inputs[0]
            if not isinstance(x, torch.Tensor) or x.shape[-1] != module.in_features:
                return output
            return output + self.adapters[safe_name](x)
        return hook

    # ── 🧠 внимание: Q/K/V ──
    def _apply_qkv(self):
        for name, module in self.base_model.named_modules():
            if not isinstance(module, nn.MultiheadAttention):
                continue
            if not getattr(module, "_qkv_same_embed_dim", False):
                continue
            w = getattr(module, "in_proj_weight", None)
            if w is None or w.shape[0] != 3 * module.embed_dim:
                continue
            safe = (name + "_qkv").replace(".", "_")
            adapter = QKVLoRA(module.embed_dim, self.rank, self.alpha)
            adapter.to(device=w.device, dtype=torch.float32)
            self.qkv_adapters[safe] = adapter
            self._qkv_map[safe] = name
            self._qkv_hooks.append(
                module.register_forward_pre_hook(self._qkv_pre(safe)))
            self._qkv_hooks.append(
                module.register_forward_hook(self._qkv_post(safe)))

        if self.qkv_adapters and not self._qkv_selftest():
            self._disable_qkv()

    def _qkv_pre(self, safe: str):
        def hook(mod, args):
            if not self._active:
                return None
            # 🩺 самолечение: если прошлый forward упал и патч остался — снимаем
            stale = self._qkv_orig.pop(safe, None)
            if stale is not None:
                mod._parameters["in_proj_weight"] = stale
            orig = mod._parameters.get("in_proj_weight")
            if orig is None:
                return None
            try:
                delta = self.qkv_adapters[safe].delta().to(orig.dtype)
                self._qkv_orig[safe] = orig
                mod._parameters["in_proj_weight"] = orig + delta
            except Exception:
                self._qkv_orig.pop(safe, None)
            return None
        return hook

    def _qkv_post(self, safe: str):
        def hook(mod, inputs, output):
            orig = self._qkv_orig.pop(safe, None)
            if orig is not None:
                mod._parameters["in_proj_weight"] = orig
            return output
        return hook

    def _restore_qkv(self):
        """Снимает все временные патчи in_proj_weight."""
        if not self._qkv_orig:
            return
        modules = dict(self.base_model.named_modules())
        for safe, orig in list(self._qkv_orig.items()):
            mod = modules.get(self._qkv_map.get(safe, ""))
            if mod is not None:
                try:
                    mod._parameters["in_proj_weight"] = orig
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self._qkv_orig.pop(safe, None)

    def _qkv_selftest(self) -> bool:
        """Один пробный forward+backward: работает ли патч на этом torch.
        Если нет — честно отключаем QKV, а не ломаем обучение."""
        safe = next(iter(self.qkv_adapters), None)
        if safe is None:
            return True
        modules = dict(self.base_model.named_modules())
        mod = modules.get(self._qkv_map[safe])
        if mod is None:
            return False
        w = mod._parameters.get("in_proj_weight")
        if w is None:
            return False
        adapter = self.qkv_adapters[safe]
        try:
            with torch.enable_grad():
                x = torch.zeros(1, 4, mod.embed_dim, device=w.device, dtype=w.dtype)
                out = mod(x, x, x, need_weights=False)
                t = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
                t.float().sum().backward()
            ok = adapter.q_A.grad is not None and bool(adapter.q_A.grad.abs().sum() > 0)
            adapter.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            self._restore_qkv()
            if ok:
                print(f"🧠 [LORA_QKV]: внимание обучается "
                      f"({len(self.qkv_adapters)} блоков, "
                      f"{sum(a.get_param_count() for a in self.qkv_adapters.values()):,} параметров)")
            return ok
        except Exception as e:
            adapter.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            self._restore_qkv()
            print(f"⚠️ [LORA_QKV]: этот torch не принял патч внимания ({str(e)[:90]})")
            return False

    def _disable_qkv(self):
        self._restore_qkv()
        for h in self._qkv_hooks:
            try:
                h.remove()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._qkv_hooks.clear()
        self.qkv_adapters.clear()
        self._qkv_map.clear()
        print("ℹ️ [LORA_QKV]: работаю на классической LoRA (out_proj + FFN)")

    # ── управление ──
    def set_active(self, active: bool):
        self._active = bool(active)
        if not self._active:
            self._restore_qkv()

    def remove_hooks(self):
        self._restore_qkv()
        for h in self._hooks + self._qkv_hooks:
            try:
                h.remove()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._hooks.clear()
        self._qkv_hooks.clear()

    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
        return self.base_model(*args, **kwargs)

    def get_trainable_param_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(p.numel() for p in self.trainable_parameters())

    def trainable_parameters(self):
        params = [p for p in self.adapters.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
        params += [p for p in self.qkv_adapters.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
        return params

    # ── сохранение / загрузка ──
    def save_adapter(self, path: str):
        from safetensors.torch import save_file
        p = Path(path)
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tensors = {}
        for safe, adapter in self.adapters.items():
            tensors[f"{safe}.lora_A"] = adapter.lora_A.detach().cpu().contiguous()
            tensors[f"{safe}.lora_B"] = adapter.lora_B.detach().cpu().contiguous()
        for safe, adapter in self.qkv_adapters.items():
            for tag in ("q", "k", "v"):
                for part in ("A", "B"):
                    key = f"{safe}.{tag}_{part}"
                    tensors[key] = getattr(adapter, f"{tag}_{part}").detach().cpu().contiguous()
        meta = {
            "rank": str(self.rank),
            "alpha": str(self.alpha),
            "targets": ",".join(self.target_names),
            "modules": ",".join(self._name_map.keys()),
            "qkv_modules": ",".join(self._qkv_map.keys()),
            "version": "3",
        }
        tmp = p.with_suffix(".tmp")
        save_file(tensors, str(tmp), metadata=meta)
        tmp.replace(p)
        print(f"💾 [LORA]: адаптер сохранён: {p.name}")

    def load_adapter(self, path: str):
        from safetensors.torch import load_file
        state = load_file(str(path))
        loaded = 0
        for safe, adapter in self.adapters.items():
            a, b = state.get(f"{safe}.lora_A"), state.get(f"{safe}.lora_B")
            if a is not None and b is not None and a.shape == adapter.lora_A.shape:
                adapter.lora_A.data.copy_(a.to(adapter.lora_A.device))
                adapter.lora_B.data.copy_(b.to(adapter.lora_B.device))
                loaded += 1
        qkv_loaded = 0
        for safe, adapter in self.qkv_adapters.items():
            got = True
            for tag in ("q", "k", "v"):
                for part in ("A", "B"):
                    t = state.get(f"{safe}.{tag}_{part}")
                    ref = getattr(adapter, f"{tag}_{part}")
                    if t is None or t.shape != ref.shape:
                        got = False
                        break
                    ref.data.copy_(t.to(ref.device))
                if not got:
                    break
            if got:
                qkv_loaded += 1
        print(f"📥 [LORA]: загружено {loaded}/{len(self.adapters)} линейных, "
              f"{qkv_loaded}/{len(self.qkv_adapters)} блоков внимания из {Path(path).name}")
        return loaded + qkv_loaded

    # ── слияние в базовые веса ──
    @torch.no_grad()
    def merge_into_base(self) -> int:
        self._restore_qkv()
        merged = 0
        modules = dict(self.base_model.named_modules())

        for safe, adapter in self.adapters.items():
            module = modules.get(self._name_map.get(safe))
            if not isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                continue
            delta = (adapter.lora_B @ adapter.lora_A) * adapter.scaling
            if delta.shape != module.weight.shape:
                continue
            module.weight.data += delta.to(module.weight.dtype)
            adapter.lora_B.data.zero_()
            merged += 1

        for safe, adapter in self.qkv_adapters.items():
            module = modules.get(self._qkv_map.get(safe))
            if module is None:
                continue
            w = module._parameters.get("in_proj_weight")
            if w is None:
                continue
            delta = adapter.delta()
            if delta.shape != w.shape:
                continue
            w.data += delta.to(w.dtype)
            adapter.zero_b()
            merged += 1

        return merged


def create_lora_adapter(base_model: nn.Module, rank: int = 8,
                        alpha: float = 16.0, dropout: float = 0.05,
                        target_modules: Optional[List[str]] = None,
                        use_qkv: bool = True) -> LoRAModel:
    return LoRAModel(base_model, rank, alpha, dropout, target_modules, use_qkv)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
🎓 MERGE v2.0 — слияние LoRA-адаптера (.safetensors) в ядро.
ΔW = (alpha / rank) * (B @ A). Адаптер удаляется после успешного merge.
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any


def _read_adapter(adapter_path: str):
    from safetensors import safe_open
    from safetensors.torch import load_file
    state = load_file(str(adapter_path))
    meta = {}
    with safe_open(str(adapter_path), framework="pt") as f:
        meta = f.metadata() or {}
    rank = int(meta.get("rank", 8))
    alpha = float(meta.get("alpha", 16.0))
    return state, rank, alpha


def merge_adapter_to_core(core_model: nn.Module, adapter_path: str,
                          device: str = "cuda", backup: bool = True) -> bool:
    """Вливает адаптер в ядро. Ядро должно быть загружено (веса в памяти)."""
    path = Path(adapter_path)
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"❌ [MERGE]: адаптер не найден: {path}")
        return False

    print(f"🎓 [MERGE]: слияние {path.name} в ядро...")
    try:
        state, rank, alpha = _read_adapter(path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ [MERGE]: ошибка чтения адаптера: {e}")
        return False

    scaling = alpha / max(rank, 1)

    # 1. Backup ядра через его собственный менеджер весов
    if backup and hasattr(core_model, "save_weights"):
        try:
            core_model.save_weights()
            print("   💾 backup ядра создан (.bak/.old через save_weights)")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"   ⚠️ [MERGE]: backup не удался: {e}")

    # 2. Собираем пары A/B по префиксу
    pairs: Dict[str, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = {}
    for key, tensor in state.items():
        if key.endswith(".lora_A"):
            pairs.setdefault(key[:-7], {})["A"] = tensor
        elif key.endswith(".lora_B"):
            pairs.setdefault(key[:-7], {})["B"] = tensor

    modules = {n.replace(".", "_"): m for n, m in core_model.named_modules()}
    merged = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for safe, ab in pairs.items():
            if "A" not in ab or "B" not in ab:
                continue
            module = modules.get(safe)
            if not isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                continue
            delta = (ab["B"].to(torch.float32) @ ab["A"].to(torch.float32)) * scaling
            if delta.shape != module.weight.shape:
                print(f"   ⚠️ пропуск {safe}: форма {tuple(delta.shape)} != {tuple(module.weight.shape)}")
                continue
            module.weight.data += delta.to(module.weight.dtype)
            merged += 1

    print(f"✅ [MERGE]: влито слоёв: {merged}")
    if merged == 0:
        print("🛑 [MERGE]: ничего не влито — адаптер НЕ удаляю")
        return False

    # 3. Сохраняем ядро и удаляем адаптер (scratch не должен становиться личностью)
    if hasattr(core_model, "save_weights"):
        core_model.save_weights()
    try:
        path.unlink()
        print(f"   🗑️ адаптер удалён: {path.name}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   ⚠️ не удалось удалить адаптер: {e}")
    return True


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_merged_model(core_model: nn.Module, test_data: List[str],
                          tokenizer, device: str = "cuda") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Оценка ядра после merge: perplexity + top-1 accuracy."""
    core_model.eval()
    total_loss, correct, total, samples = 0.0, 0, 0, 0
    max_id = core_model.embedding.num_embeddings - 1 if hasattr(core_model, "embedding") else None

    for text in test_data:
        ids = tokenizer.encode(text, max_len=256)
        if len(ids) < 4:
            continue
        t = torch.tensor([ids], dtype=torch.long)
        if max_id is not None:
            t = t.clamp(0, max_id)
        t = t.to(device)

        out = core_model(t)
        logits = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
        shift_logits = logits[:, :-1, :].float()
        shift_labels = t[:, 1:]

        loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(
            shift_logits.reshape(-1, shift_logits.size(-1)),
            shift_labels.reshape(-1), ignore_index=0)
        total_loss += loss.item()
        correct += (shift_logits.argmax(-1) == shift_labels).sum().item()
        total += shift_labels.numel()
        samples += 1

    results = {
        "samples_tested": samples,
        "perplexity": float(torch.exp(torch.tensor(total_loss / max(samples, 1)))),
        "accuracy": correct / max(total, 1),
    }
    print(f"🎓 [EVAL]: perplexity={results['perplexity']:.2f}, "
          f"accuracy={results['accuracy']:.2%}")
    return results

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
🎓 SCRATCH MANAGER — Менеджер системы обучения
Координирует:
- Создание адаптеров
- Обучение на данных
- Проверку качества
- Слияние в ядро
- Очистку временных файлов
"""
import os
import torch
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List
import time
import json

from weights.scratch.lora_adapter import create_lora_adapter
from weights.scratch.trainer import Trainer, TextDataset
from weights.scratch.merge import merge_adapter_to_core, evaluate_merged_model

class ScratchManager:
    """Менеджер системы обучения."""

    def __init__(self, scratch_dir: Path):
        self.scratch_dir = Path(scratch_dir)
        self.adapters_dir = self.scratch_dir / "adapters"
        self.checkpoints_dir = self.scratch_dir / "checkpoints"
        self.eval_dir = self.scratch_dir / "eval"
        self.temp_dir = self.scratch_dir / "temp"

        # Создаём структуру
        for dir_path in [self.adapters_dir, self.checkpoints_dir, self.eval_dir, self.temp_dir]:
            dir_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # Активные сессии обучения
        self.active_sessions: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

        print(f"🎓 [SCRATCH]: Менеджер обучения инициализирован")
        print(f"   📁 Путь: {self.scratch_dir}")

    def create_adapter(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        base_model: torch.nn.Module,
        rank: int = 8,
        alpha: float = 16.0,
        dropout: float = 0.1,
    ) -> str:
        """Создаёт новый LoRA-адаптер для обучения."""
        print(f"🎓 [SCRATCH]: Создаю адаптер для сессии '{session_id}'...")

        # Создаём LoRA-модель
        lora_model = create_lora_adapter(base_model, rank, alpha, dropout)

        # Сохраняем сессию
        self.active_sessions[session_id] = {
            "model": lora_model,
            "base_model": base_model,
            "rank": rank,
            "alpha": alpha,
            "created_at": time.time(),
            "status": "created",
        }

        print(f"   ✅ Адаптер создан (rank={rank}, alpha={alpha})")
        print(f"   📊 Обучаемых параметров: {lora_model.get_trainable_param_count():,}")

        return session_id

    def train_adapter(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        texts: List[str],
        tokenizer,
        learning_rate: float = 1e-4,
        batch_size: int = 4,
        max_epochs: int = 3,
        eval_split: float = 0.1,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Обучает адаптер на текстовых данных."""
        if session_id not in self.active_sessions:
            raise ValueError(f"Сессия '{session_id}' не найдена")

        session = self.active_sessions[session_id]
        model = session["model"]

        print(f"🎓 [SCRATCH]: Обучаю адаптер '{session_id}'...")
        print(f"   📚 Примеров: {len(texts)}")

        # Разделяем на train/eval
        eval_size = int(len(texts) * eval_split)
        train_texts = texts[:-eval_size] if eval_size > 0 else texts
        eval_texts = texts[-eval_size:] if eval_size > 0 else []

        # Создаём датасеты
        train_dataset = TextDataset(train_texts, tokenizer)
        eval_dataset = TextDataset(eval_texts, tokenizer) if eval_texts else None

        # Создаём тренер
        trainer = Trainer(
            model=model,
            tokenizer=tokenizer,
            learning_rate=learning_rate,
            batch_size=batch_size,
            max_epochs=max_epochs,
        )

        # Обучаем
        results = trainer.train(train_dataset, eval_dataset)

        # Обновляем статус
        session["status"] = "trained"
        session["training_results"] = results
        session["trained_at"] = time.time()

        # Сохраняем адаптер
        adapter_path = self.adapters_dir / f"{session_id}_lora.safetensors"
        model.save_adapter(str(adapter_path))

        # Сохраняем чекпоинт
        checkpoint_path = self.checkpoints_dir / f"{session_id}_train.pt"
        trainer.save_checkpoint(str(checkpoint_path), epoch=max_epochs, step=0)

        print(f"   ✅ Обучение завершено")
        print(f"   💾 Адаптер: {adapter_path}")
        print(f"   💾 Чекпоинт: {checkpoint_path}")

        return results

    def evaluate_adapter(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        test_texts: List[str],
        tokenizer,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Оценивает качество обученного адаптера."""
        if session_id not in self.active_sessions:
            raise ValueError(f"Сессия '{session_id}' не найдена")

        session = self.active_sessions[session_id]
        model = session["model"]

        print(f"🎓 [SCRATCH]: Оцениваю адаптер '{session_id}'...")

        # Оцениваем
        results = evaluate_merged_model(model, test_texts, tokenizer)

        # Сохраняем отчёт
        report_path = self.eval_dir / f"{session_id}_eval_report.json"
        with open(report_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(results, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        print(f"   📊 Отчёт сохранён: {report_path}")

        return results

    def merge_to_core(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        core_model: torch.nn.Module,
        backup: bool = True,
    ) -> bool:
        """Вливает обученный адаптер в базовое ядро."""
        if session_id not in self.active_sessions:
            raise ValueError(f"Сессия '{session_id}' не найдена")

        session = self.active_sessions[session_id]
        adapter_path = self.adapters_dir / f"{session_id}_lora.safetensors"

        if not adapter_path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Адаптер не найден: {adapter_path}")

        print(f"🎓 [SCRATCH]: Вливаю адаптер '{session_id}' в ядро...")

        # Merge
        success = merge_adapter_to_core(
            core_model=core_model,
            adapter_path=str(adapter_path),
            backup=backup,
        )

        if success:
            # Обновляем статус
            session["status"] = "merged"
            session["merged_at"] = time.time()

            # Удаляем сессию (адаптер уже удалён в merge)
            del self.active_sessions[session_id]

            # Удаляем чекпоинт
            checkpoint_path = self.checkpoints_dir / f"{session_id}_train.pt"
            if checkpoint_path.exists():
                checkpoint_path.unlink()
                print(f"   🗑️ Чекпоинт удалён: {checkpoint_path}")

            print(f"   ✅ Merge завершён")

        return success

    def cleanup_session(self, session_id: str):
        """Удаляет все файлы сессии."""
        if session_id in self.active_sessions:
            del self.active_sessions[session_id]

        # Удаляем файлы
        for file_pattern in [
            f"{session_id}_lora.safetensors",
            f"{session_id}_train.pt",
            f"{session_id}_eval_report.json",
        ]:
            for dir_path in [self.adapters_dir, self.checkpoints_dir, self.eval_dir]:
                file_path = dir_path / file_pattern
                if file_path.exists():
                    file_path.unlink()

        print(f"🗑️ [SCRATCH]: Сессия '{session_id}' удалена")

    def get_session_status(self, session_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Возвращает статус сессии."""
        if session_id not in self.active_sessions:
            return None

        session = self.active_sessions[session_id]
        return {
            "session_id": session_id,
            "status": session.get("status", "unknown"),
            "rank": session.get("rank"),
            "alpha": session.get("alpha"),
            "created_at": session.get("created_at"),
            "trained_at": session.get("trained_at"),
            "merged_at": session.get("merged_at"),
            "training_results": session.get("training_results"),
        }

    def list_sessions(self) -> List[str]:
        """Возвращает список активных сессий."""
        return list(self.active_sessions.keys())

    def get_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Возвращает статистику системы обучения."""
        adapters_count = len(list(self.adapters_dir.glob("*.safetensors")))
        checkpoints_count = len(list(self.checkpoints_dir.glob("*.pt")))
        eval_reports_count = len(list(self.eval_dir.glob("*.json")))

        return {
            "active_sessions": len(self.active_sessions),
            "adapters_saved": adapters_count,
            "checkpoints_saved": checkpoints_count,
            "eval_reports": eval_reports_count,
        }

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
🎓 ТРЕНЕР
Обучает LoRA-адаптер на данных.
Поддерживает:
- Книги (текст → продолжение)
- Код (код → следующий блок)
- Словари (слово → определение)
- Диалоги (вопрос → ответ)
"""
import os
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
import time


class TextDataset(Dataset):
    """Датасет для текстовых данных."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        texts: List[str],
        tokenizer,
        max_length: int = 512,
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        # Токенизация
        input_ids = self.tokenizer.encode(text, max_len=self.max_length)
        input_ids = torch.tensor(input_ids, dtype=torch.long)

        # Вход и таргет (сдвиг на 1)
        x = input_ids[:-1]
        y = input_ids[1:]

        return {"input_ids": x, "labels": y}


class Trainer:
    """Тренер для LoRA-адаптера."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        tokenizer,
        device: str = "cuda",
        learning_rate: float = 1e-4,
        batch_size: int = 4,
        max_epochs: int = 3,
        grad_accumulation_steps: int = 4,
    ):
        self.model = model
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.device = device
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.max_epochs = max_epochs
        self.grad_accumulation_steps = grad_accumulation_steps

        # Переносим модель на устройство
        self.model.to(device)

        # Оптимизатор (только для обучаемых параметров)
        trainable_params = [p for p in self.model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
        self.optimizer = optim.AdamW(trainable_params, lr=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)

        # Scheduler
        self.scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
            self.optimizer, T_max=max_epochs
        )

        # Метрики
        self.training_loss = []
        self.best_loss = float("inf")

        print(f"🎓 [TRAINER]: Тренер инициализирован")
        print(f"   📊 Обучаемых параметров: {sum(p.numel() for p in trainable_params):,}")
        print(f"   🎯 LR: {learning_rate}, Batch: {batch_size}, Epochs: {max_epochs}")

    def train(self, dataset: Dataset, eval_dataset: Optional[Dataset] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Обучает модель на датасете."""
        dataloader = DataLoader(
            dataset,
            batch_size=self.batch_size,
            shuffle=True,
            num_workers=0,  # Windows compatibility
        )

        eval_dataloader = None
        if eval_dataset:
            eval_dataloader = DataLoader(
                eval_dataset,
                batch_size=self.batch_size,
                shuffle=False,
                num_workers=0,
            )

        print(f"🎓 [TRAIN]: Начинаю обучение ({len(dataset)} примеров)...")

        for epoch in range(self.max_epochs):
            self.model.train()
            epoch_loss = 0.0
            num_batches = 0

            for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(dataloader):
                input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(self.device)
                labels = batch["labels"].to(self.device)

                # Forward pass
                outputs = self.model(input_ids)

                # Loss (cross-entropy)
                if isinstance(outputs, torch.Tensor):
                    logits = outputs
                else:
                    logits = outputs.logits if hasattr(outputs, "logits") else outputs

                # Shift logits and labels for next-token prediction
                shift_logits = logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()
                shift_labels = labels[..., 1:].contiguous()

                loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(
                    shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1)),
                    shift_labels.view(-1),
                    ignore_index=-100,
                )

                # Normalize loss by accumulation steps
                loss = loss / self.grad_accumulation_steps

                # Backward pass
                loss.backward()

                # Gradient accumulation
                if (batch_idx + 1) % self.grad_accumulation_steps == 0:
                    # Gradient clipping
                    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)

                    # Optimizer step
                    self.optimizer.step()
                    self.scheduler.step()
                    self.optimizer.zero_grad()

                epoch_loss += loss.item() * self.grad_accumulation_steps
                num_batches += 1

                # Лог каждые 10 батчей
                if (batch_idx + 1) % 10 == 0:
                    avg_loss = epoch_loss / num_batches
                    print(f"   📊 Batch {batch_idx + 1}/{len(dataloader)}, Loss: {avg_loss:.4f}")

            # Конец эпохи
            avg_epoch_loss = epoch_loss / max(num_batches, 1)
            self.training_loss.append(avg_epoch_loss)

            print(f"🎓 [EPOCH {epoch + 1}/{self.max_epochs}]: Avg Loss: {avg_epoch_loss:.4f}")

            # Evaluation
            if eval_dataloader:
                eval_loss = self.evaluate(eval_dataloader)
                print(f"   📊 Eval Loss: {eval_loss:.4f}")

                # Сохраняем лучший чекпоинт
                if eval_loss < self.best_loss:
                    self.best_loss = eval_loss
                    print(f"   ✅ Новый лучший чекпоинт!")

        print(f"✅ [TRAIN]: Обучение завершено. Best Loss: {self.best_loss:.4f}")

        return {
            "final_loss": self.training_loss[-1] if self.training_loss else 0.0,
            "best_loss": self.best_loss,
            "epochs": self.max_epochs,
            "training_loss": self.training_loss,
        }

    def evaluate(self, dataloader: DataLoader) -> float:
        """Оценивает модель на eval-датасете."""
        self.model.eval()
        total_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0

        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in dataloader:
                input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(self.device)
                labels = batch["labels"].to(self.device)

                outputs = self.model(input_ids)

                if isinstance(outputs, torch.Tensor):
                    logits = outputs
                else:
                    logits = outputs.logits if hasattr(outputs, "logits") else outputs

                shift_logits = logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()
                shift_labels = labels[..., 1:].contiguous()

                loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(
                    shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1)),
                    shift_labels.view(-1),
                    ignore_index=-100,
                )

                total_loss += loss.item()
                num_batches += 1

        avg_loss = total_loss / max(num_batches, 1)
        return avg_loss

    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str, epoch: int, step: int):
        """Сохраняет чекпоинт с оптимизатором."""
        checkpoint = {
            "epoch": epoch,
            "step": step,
            "model_state_dict": self.model.state_dict(),
            "optimizer_state_dict": self.optimizer.state_dict(),
            "scheduler_state_dict": self.scheduler.state_dict(),
            "best_loss": self.best_loss,
            "training_loss": self.training_loss,
        }
        torch.save(checkpoint, path)
        print(f"💾 [CHECKPOINT]: Сохранён: {path}")

    def load_checkpoint(self, path: str):
        """Загружает чекпоинт."""
        checkpoint = torch.load(path, map_location=self.device)
        self.model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model_state_dict"])
        self.optimizer.load_state_dict(checkpoint["optimizer_state_dict"])
        self.scheduler.load_state_dict(checkpoint["scheduler_state_dict"])
        self.best_loss = checkpoint.get("best_loss", float("inf"))
        self.training_loss = checkpoint.get("training_loss", [])
        print(f"📥 [CHECKPOINT]: Загружен: {path}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
🔍 БАЗОВЫЙ КЛАСС ВЕКТОРНОГО ИНДЕКСА
Хранит эмбеддинги в safetensors, ищет через cosine similarity на GPU.
Атомарная запись + backup-политика.
"""
import os
import torch
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional


class VectorIndex:
    """Векторный индекс для одной категории памяти."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        index_path: Path,
        embedding_dim: int = 312,  # rubert-tiny2 = 312
        dtype: str = "fp16",
        priority: str = "P1",
    ):
        self.index_path = Path(index_path)
        self.embedding_dim = embedding_dim
        self.dtype = self._parse_dtype(dtype)
        self.priority = priority

        # Данные
        self.vectors = None  # torch.Tensor [N, dim]
        self.metadata = []   # List[dict] — {id, text, timestamp, ...}

        # Загружаем если есть
        self._load()

    def _parse_dtype(self, dtype: str) -> torch.dtype:
        """int8 для эмбеддингов запрещён: значения лежат в [-1, 1]
        и при касте в int8 превращаются в нули — индекс становится мёртвым."""
        key = str(dtype).lower()
        if key == "int8":
            print("⚠️ [VECTOR_INDEX]: int8 обнуляет эмбеддинги — использую fp16.")
            return torch.float16
        return {
            "fp32": torch.float32,
            "fp16": torch.float16,
            "bf16": torch.bfloat16,
        }.get(key, torch.float16)

    def _load(self):
        """Загружает индекс с диска."""
        if not self.index_path.exists():
            self.vectors = torch.zeros((0, self.embedding_dim), dtype=self.dtype)
            self.metadata = []
            return

        try:
            from safetensors.torch import load_file
            data = load_file(str(self.index_path))

            if "vectors" in data:
                self.vectors = data["vectors"]
            else:
                self.vectors = torch.zeros((0, self.embedding_dim), dtype=self.dtype)

            if "metadata" in data:
                # Метаданные хранятся как JSON-строка в тензоре
                import json
                metadata_bytes = data["metadata"].numpy().tobytes()
                self.metadata = json.loads(metadata_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
            else:
                self.metadata = []

            print(f"🔍 [VECTOR_INDEX]: Загружен {self.index_path.name} "
                  f"({len(self.metadata)} записей)")

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [VECTOR_INDEX_LOAD_ERR]: {e}")
            self.vectors = torch.zeros((0, self.embedding_dim), dtype=self.dtype)
            self.metadata = []

    def save(self):
        """Сохраняет индекс на диск (атомарно)."""
        try:
            from safetensors.torch import save_file
            import json

            # Backup-политика
            if self.priority in ("P0", "P1"):
                bak_path = self.index_path.with_suffix(".safetensors.bak")
                old_path = self.index_path.with_suffix(".safetensors.old")

                if bak_path.exists():
                    if old_path.exists():
                        old_path.unlink()
                    bak_path.rename(old_path)

                if self.index_path.exists():
                    import shutil
                    shutil.copy2(self.index_path, bak_path)

            # Сохраняем во временный файл
            temp_path = self.index_path.with_suffix(".safetensors.tmp")

            # Метаданные → JSON → bytes → tensor
            metadata_json = json.dumps(self.metadata, ensure_ascii=False)
            metadata_bytes = metadata_json.encode("utf-8")
            metadata_array = np.frombuffer(metadata_bytes, dtype=np.uint8)
            metadata_tensor = torch.from_numpy(metadata_array.copy())

            data = {
                "vectors": self.vectors.cpu(),
                "metadata": metadata_tensor,
            }

            save_file(data, str(temp_path))

            # Атомарная замена
            os.replace(temp_path, self.index_path)

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [VECTOR_INDEX_SAVE_ERR]: {e}")
            # Чистим временный файл
            temp_path = self.index_path.with_suffix(".safetensors.tmp")
            if temp_path.exists():
                try:
                    temp_path.unlink()
                except Exception:
                    pass

    def add(self, vector: torch.Tensor, metadata: dict):
        """Добавляет вектор в индекс."""
        if vector.shape[0] != self.embedding_dim:
            raise ValueError(f"Размерность вектора {vector.shape[0]} != {self.embedding_dim}")

        # Приводим к нужному dtype
        vector = vector.to(dtype=self.dtype)

        # Добавляем
        if self.vectors.shape[0] == 0:
            self.vectors = vector.unsqueeze(0)
        else:
            self.vectors = torch.cat([self.vectors, vector.unsqueeze(0)], dim=0)

        self.metadata.append(metadata)

    def remove(self, index: int):
        """Удаляет вектор по индексу."""
        if 0 <= index < len(self.metadata):
            self.vectors = torch.cat([
                self.vectors[:index],
                self.vectors[index + 1:]
            ], dim=0)
            self.metadata.pop(index)

    def search(
        self,
        query_vector: torch.Tensor,
        top_k: int = 5,
        threshold: float = 0.5,
    ) -> List[Tuple[float, dict]]:
        """Ищет ближайшие векторы через cosine similarity (счёт в float32)."""
        if self.vectors is None or self.vectors.shape[0] == 0:
            return []
        vectors = self.vectors.to(dtype=torch.float32)
        query = query_vector.to(dtype=torch.float32, device=vectors.device)
        query_norm = torch.norm(query)
        if query_norm < 1e-8:
            return []
        vectors_norm = torch.norm(vectors, dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-8)
        scores = (vectors @ query) / (vectors_norm.squeeze() * query_norm)
        top_scores, top_indices = torch.topk(scores, min(top_k, len(scores)))
        results = []
        for score, idx in zip(top_scores, top_indices):
            score_val = score.item()
            if score_val >= threshold:
                results.append((score_val, self.metadata[idx.item()]))
        return results

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.metadata)

    def get_stats(self) -> dict:
        """Статистика индекса."""
        return {
            "path": str(self.index_path),
            "count": len(self.metadata),
            "embedding_dim": self.embedding_dim,
            "dtype": str(self.dtype),
            "priority": self.priority,
            "size_mb": self.index_path.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024) if self.index_path.exists() else 0,
        }

# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# 🔍 МЕНЕДЖЕР ВЕКТОРНЫХ ИНДЕКСОВ
# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
"""
🔍 МЕНЕДЖЕР ВЕКТОРНЫХ ИНДЕКСОВ
Управляет всеми векторными индексами, синхронизирует с SQLite базами.
Использует rubert-tiny2 для эмбеддингов.
"""

import os
import torch
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional

from weights.vectors.vector_index import VectorIndex


class VectorManager:
    """Менеджер всех векторных индексов."""

    # Конфигурация индексов (переделка-2: + body, + self_code)
    INDEX_CONFIG = {
        # P0 — критические
        "profile": {"priority": "P0", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "creator": {"priority": "P0", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "eternal": {"priority": "P0", "dtype": "fp16"},
        # P1 — очень важные
        "emotions": {"priority": "P1", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "relationships": {"priority": "P1", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "intimacy": {"priority": "P1", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "facts": {"priority": "P1", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "body": {"priority": "P1", "dtype": "fp16"},           # 🆕 телесные ощущения
        # P2 — важные
        "interlocutors": {"priority": "P2", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "chat_hot": {"priority": "P2", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "goals": {"priority": "P2", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "masks": {"priority": "P2", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "errors": {"priority": "P2", "dtype": "fp16"},
        "self_code": {"priority": "P2", "dtype": "fp16"},      # 🆕 код Эйдена
        # P3 — можно забывать
        "archive": {"priority": "P3", "dtype": "fp16"},
    }

    def __init__(self, vectors_dir: Path, embedding_model=None, embedding_dim: int = 312):
        self.vectors_dir = Path(vectors_dir)
        self.vectors_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.embedding_dim = embedding_dim
        self.embedding_model = embedding_model
        self.tokenizer = None
        self.device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

        # Индексы
        self.indices: Dict[str, VectorIndex] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

        # Инициализируем все индексы
        self._init_indices()

        print(f"🔍 [VECTOR_MANAGER]: Менеджер инициализирован "
              f"({len(self.indices)} индексов, device={self.device})")

    def set_embedding_model(self, model, tokenizer):
        """🔌 Подключает загруженную модель эмбеддингов (из ядра Эйдена)."""
        self.embedding_model = model
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        print("🔍 [VECTOR_MANAGER]: Эмбеддинги подключены к векторным индексам.")

    def _init_indices(self):
        """Создаёт все векторные индексы."""
        for index_name, config in self.INDEX_CONFIG.items():
            index_path = self.vectors_dir / f"{index_name}_vectors.safetensors"
            index = VectorIndex(
                index_path=index_path,
                embedding_dim=self.embedding_dim,
                dtype=config["dtype"],
                priority=config["priority"],
            )
            self.indices[index_name] = index

    def _get_embedding(self, text: str) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Получает эмбеддинг текста через модель."""
        if self.embedding_model is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Embedding модель не загружена")
        if self.tokenizer is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Токенизатор эмбеддингов не подключён")

        inputs = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=128,
            padding=True,
        )
        inputs = {k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in inputs.items()}

        model = getattr(self.embedding_model, "model", self.embedding_model)
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model(**inputs)
            embedding = outputs.last_hidden_state.mean(dim=1).squeeze()
        return embedding

    def add_text(self, index_name: str, text: str, metadata: dict):
        """Добавляет текст в векторный индекс."""
        if index_name not in self.indices:
            raise ValueError(f"Индекс '{index_name}' не найден")

        with self._lock:
            vector = self._get_embedding(text)
            self.indices[index_name].add(vector, metadata)
            self.indices[index_name].save()

    def search(
        self,
        index_name: str,
        query: str,
        top_k: int = 5,
        threshold: float = 0.5,
    ) -> List[Tuple[float, dict]]:
        """Ищет в векторном индексе."""
        if index_name not in self.indices:
            raise ValueError(f"Индекс '{index_name}' не найден")

        query_vector = self._get_embedding(query)
        return self.indices[index_name].search(query_vector, top_k, threshold)

    def search_all(
        self,
        query: str,
        top_k: int = 5,
        threshold: float = 0.5,
        index_names: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, List[Tuple[float, dict]]]:
        """Ищет во всех индексах (или в указанных)."""
        if index_names is None:
            index_names = list(self.indices.keys())

        results = {}
        for index_name in index_names:
            try:
                results[index_name] = self.search(index_name, query, top_k, threshold)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ [VECTOR_SEARCH_ERR] {index_name}: {e}")
                results[index_name] = []
        return results

    def sync_from_database(self, index_name: str, db_manager, table_name: str,
                           text_column: str = "text"):
        """🔍 Синхронизация индекса с таблицей.
        Ключ строки берём через явный алиас — 'rowid' больше не теряется."""
        if index_name not in self.indices:
            raise ValueError(f"Индекс '{index_name}' не найден")
        if self.embedding_model is None or self.tokenizer is None:
            return 0

        with self._lock:
            try:
                records = db_manager.fetch_all(
                    f"{index_name}.db",
                    f"SELECT rowid AS rid, {text_column} AS txt FROM {table_name}")
            except Exception:
                try:
                    records = db_manager.fetch_all(
                        f"{index_name}.db",
                        f"SELECT id AS rid, {text_column} AS txt FROM {table_name}")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"⚠️ [VECTOR_SYNC_READ] {index_name}: {str(e)[:120]}")
                    return 0

            db_records = {}
            for r in records:
                rid, txt = r.get("rid"), r.get("txt")
                if rid is not None and txt:
                    db_records[int(rid)] = str(txt)

            existing_ids = {}
            for i, meta in enumerate(self.indices[index_name].metadata):
                if meta.get("db_rowid") is not None:
                    existing_ids[int(meta["db_rowid"])] = i

            added = 0
            for rowid, text in db_records.items():
                if rowid in existing_ids:
                    continue
                try:
                    vector = self._get_embedding(text)
                    self.indices[index_name].add(vector.detach().cpu(), {
                        "db_rowid": rowid, "text": text[:200],
                    })
                    added += 1
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"⚠️ [VECTOR_SYNC_ADD_ERR]: {str(e)[:100]}")

            removed = 0
            stale = sorted((idx for rid, idx in existing_ids.items()
                            if rid not in db_records), reverse=True)
            for idx in stale:
                try:
                    self.indices[index_name].remove(idx)
                    removed += 1
                except Exception:
                    pass

            if added or removed:
                self.indices[index_name].save()
                print(f"🔄 [VECTOR_SYNC]: {index_name} — "
                      f"добавлено {added}, удалено {removed}")
            return added
            
    def get_stats(self) -> Dict[str, dict]:
        """Статистика всех индексов."""
        return {name: idx.get_stats() for name, idx in self.indices.items()}

    def print_stats(self):
        """Печатает статистику."""
        stats = self.get_stats()
        lines = ["🔍 СТАТИСТИКА ВЕКТОРНЫХ ИНДЕКСОВ:"]
        total_count = 0
        total_size = 0
        for name, info in stats.items():
            total_count += info["count"]
            total_size += info["size_mb"]
            lines.append(f"  [{info['priority']}] {name}: {info['count']} записей, "
                        f"{info['size_mb']:.2f} МБ")
        lines.append(f"  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
        lines.append(f"  ИТОГО: {total_count} записей, {total_size:.2f} МБ")
        print("\n".join(lines))


# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# 🌍 ГЛОБАЛЬНЫЙ ЭКЗЕМПЛЯР
# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
_vector_manager = None

def init_vector_manager(vectors_dir: Path, embedding_model=None, embedding_dim: int = 312):
    """Инициализирует глобальный менеджер векторов."""
    global _vector_manager
    if _vector_manager is None:
        _vector_manager = VectorManager(vectors_dir, embedding_model, embedding_dim)
    return _vector_manager

def get_vector_manager():
    """Возвращает глобальный менеджер векторов."""
    return _vector_manager
